شَيَمٌ : see 1, near the end. ＝
-A2- Also Any land, or ground, in which one has not yet dug, remaining in its [original] hard state, (Aboo-Sa'eed, K, TA,) so that the digging therein is more difficult [than elsewhere] to the digger. (Aboo-Sa'eed, TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
